_comment: Concept-mapping configuration (scripts/concept_mapping.py, references/ontology-mapping.md). Every mapping is still TOOL-ONLY (SKILL.md rule 15): a trusted ontology file is a tool — a match is a lookup in a curated artifact, never model knowledge. Edit this file, not code.
_sources_priority: Order in which mapping sources are consulted. An item is sent to the next source only if every earlier one left it unmapped. Default: the trusted ontology files in trusted_ontologes/ first; then the local hybrid mapper if it is running; then OLS through its MCP server (remote.ols_mcp_url, exact label matches only); BioPortal last (needs BIOPORTAL_API_KEY). Allowed: trusted, local_hybrid, ols (MCP), ols_rest (the REST search API), bioportal. Remove a source to disable it.

trusted_ontologies._directory: Relative to the skill root (or absolute). Every file listed below must live here.
trusted_ontologies._priority_file: The editable priority table (Priority | Name | File | CURIE prefix | Labels | Notes). It is the ONLY place trusted ontologies and their order are defined.
trusted_ontologies._strategy: 'priority': the highest-priority ontology (trusted_ontologes/priority.md) with ANY accepted match wins; label_routing order breaks ties inside one file. 'best_match': the strongest match type across all eligible ontologies wins; priority breaks ties.
trusted_ontologies._match_on: Which OWL annotations count as a match, strongest first. Add related_synonym / narrow_synonym / broad_synonym to widen recall; their tiers are set in match_type_tiers, so a weaker match is never written as exactMatch.

match_properties._comment: Annotation property IRIs that feed each match type. Add your ontology's properties here (e.g. skos:altLabel) rather than in code.
label: http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label
http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#prefLabel

trusted_ontologies._entity_types: rdf:type values that make a node a mappable term.
trusted_ontologies._lexicon_dir: Where `index` writes <name>.tsv.gz (one flat lexicon per ontology) and lexicon.sqlite (the lookup index). Regenerable; safe to delete.
trusted_ontologies._index_local_name_when_unlabeled: Some ontologies (SCIO, NEO, BRAIN-COF) name classes only in the IRI (…/AdhesiveRemovalTest). When a class has no label, index its IRI local name as match type 'local_name'.
trusted_ontologies._abbreviation_guard: A query of <= max_length alphanumeric characters (PFC, LTP, V1) matches exact synonyms/symbols in many ontologies (FBbt 'prefollicle cell' for PFC). It is only mapped — and only used to derive a key — when the item's label has a label_routing entry, so the route decides which ontologies may answer.
trusted_ontologies._exclude_iri_patterns: Regexes over candidate IRIs that are never mapping targets: terms a trusted file declares that are not domain concepts. BKE's '<Enum>#<value>' IRIs (AbbreviationEntityType#gene, AuthorityType#NCBI, ANATOMICALDIRECTION#..., Region#...) are schema permissible values; matching them maps the generic word 'gene' to an enum value. Applied at query time, no re-index.
trusted_ontologies._fallback_match_on: Weaker synonym types tried only when no label/exact synonym matches in any eligible ontology; graded by match_type_tiers (broad_synonym -> narrowMatch, narrow_synonym -> broadMatch, related_synonym -> relatedMatch) and reviewed by the mapping judge. Remove to require identity-strength matches only.

label_routing._comment: Extractor label -> id prefixes acceptable for that label, in preference order. A FILTER, never a reordering of trusted ontologies (priority.md decides that): a candidate under a listed prefix, or under the trusted row's own CURIE prefix, is accepted. Labels absent here accept any prefix. The same list is passed to remote mappers as their ontology filter.
label_routing._general_domain: General-domain labels route to [] — no trusted (biomedical) ontology may answer for a Person or an Organization; remote sources are still consulted (use a general-domain mapper there, e.g. a Wikidata-backed local service).

match_type_tiers._comment: Honest skos tier implied by HOW the tool matched, used when no judge or kg_plan set one. A narrow synonym of T names something narrower than T, so T is BROADER than the entity.
match_type_tiers.label: exactMatch

remote._ols_mcp_url: OLS MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no key). Its searchClasses tool ranks loosely and returns no synonyms, so only a class whose label equals the query is accepted (scripts/ols_mcp_map.py).
remote._max_results: Hits fetched per remote search; the first one in a representable namespace (prefix registry) is taken, not blindly hit 1.

label_ontologies._comment: Remote-only routes (BioPortal acronyms) for labels label_routing leaves open, so a search never spans all of BioPortal. Does not affect trusted-ontology filtering.

remote._default_ontologies: Remote search scope for a label with no route at all (KeyTerm, Other, invented labels): well-curated ontologies the TTL can represent. Empty list = unrestricted (not recommended: LOINC/SNOMED/CRISP noise).

curated_mappings._comment: User-curated overrides, consulted before every other source: '<term>|<label>' or '<term>' -> mapping. Only for terms the ontology files systematically get wrong (NCBITaxon puts the common names 'mice'/'rats' under the genus). Edit freely; each hit is recorded as mapping_source 'curated'.
